headline: Bank Indonesia Holds Policy Rate Steady and Lowers Reserve Requirement to Spurr Lending
summary: Indonesian equities trimmed losses after Bank Indonesia kept its benchmark rate unchanged while cutting the reserve requirement ratio to boost domestic liquidity and commercial lending.
why: Bank Indonesia balances currency stability with domestic credit growth in Southeast Asia's largest economy.

impacts.name: Indonesian Banking
impacts.why: Reduced reserve requirements free up liquidity for commercial banks to expand loan portfolios.

why_moved: Equities recovered early losses as the RRR reduction provided liquidity relief without the tightening pressure of a rate hike.
